sec_schema_files_sec_obb.name: Schema Files
sec_schema_files_sec_obb.description:
Explore SEC and FASB XBRL taxonomy schemas, labels, and presentation structures.

- No parameters: list all available taxonomy families.
- taxonomy only: get all parsed structures for the most recent year.
- taxonomy + year: get all parsed structures for a specific year.
- taxonomy + component: get one component's structure using the most recent year.
- taxonomy + year + component: get one component's parsed structure.

params.label: Taxonomy
params.description: Taxonomy family to explore. Omit to list all available taxonomies and their descriptions.

params.label: Year
params.description: Taxonomy year (e.g. 2011+ for us-gaap, varies by taxonomy). Defaults to the most recent year when omitted.

params.label: Component
params.description: Presentation component to retrieve. Values are taxonomy-specific. Omit to return all components for the taxonomy.

params.label: Category
params.description: Filter taxonomies by SEC filer category.

columnsDefs.headerTooltip: Identifier: taxonomy key, year, component name, or XBRL element ID depending on the query mode.

Hierarchy depth in presentation structure (0 = root).

Balance type for monetary items: 'credit' or 'debit'.

XBRL substitution group: 'item' (line item), 'dimensionItem' (axis), 'hypercubeItem' (table).
Whether the element value can be nil.
